history.source: docs/model-routing.md sections 3.3 and 5 (family F3, the bridge); docs/model-routing-review.md, Build notes (F3)
history.decision: F3: the fallback and effort_fallback edges are suggestions the bridge names when it refuses to descend, never applied on their own. A Codex seat moves to another family or effort only through its explicit preference list (astra|sol:ultra, astra:ultra|max), and only once no capable account is left; the descent is recorded and noticed. With the model registry installed, a seat is routed only to the relay accounts whose fresh catalog lists its model at the requested effort (relay's pick confined to that set in protocol 2), a relay that cannot apply the set makes the bridge validate this machine's own login instead of running it unchecked, and every attempt records the requested, expected and observed models (Codex from the attempt's own window of the rollout file, Claude from its own stream); --strict-model fails an attempt that ran another model or whose observation could not be collected
